5215.title: Command discovery skips plugin skill selection
5215.rootCauseOneLine: The commands route omits the plugin skill selection map that thread runtime supplies to the shared catalog.
5215.proposedFix: Align discovery with runtime selection after defining existing-thread and pre-thread configuration context; do not invent a thread or hard-code plugin settings.
5215.caveats: No fix PR: thread/model/origin/metadata context is absent from the command query, so a public-contract/product decision is required. In-process backend reproduction only; no browser or real provider turn. Two clean runs failed as intended; 29 existing tests passed.
